2608.28553.title: Logos: An Agent Harness on a Cross-Process Bus
2608.28553.paper_summary: Modern agent systems assemble capabilities at runtime, and this dynamic composition has recently received a complete formal treat ment in the spatiotemporal-composability calculus, in which a capability is a component carrying a tracked inverse, and agents are assembled as plugins. This plugin form is carried by a single process sharing one context, a carrier that places all components in one physical failure domain, a fault suspends every component at once, and process death interrupts every session the process hosts. This paper shows that neither the modeling nor the calculus binds an agent to one process, the statelessness of the language model keeps all cross-step state outside the model, and the soundness invariant is defined on the state space alone. These observations condense into four lemmas whose premises are the hypotheses of the calculus and the statelessness of language-model inference. On these lemmas this paper constructs Logos, a ROS-like cross process agent harness in which a plugin is a process and the only shared state is an append-only transcript. Eighty sessions resume with no repeated effect after kills placed at the four boundaries of the tool-call cycle, and a same-fault comparison with a single process reference configuration shows one fault interrupting every co-resident session while under the peer-process construction one fault ends at one node.
2608.28553.paper_summary_zh: 現代代理系統在運行時組合能力，這種動態組合最近在時空可組合性計算中得到了完整的形式處理，其中能力是一個攜帶跟踪逆的組件，而代理則作為插件組裝。這種插件形式由一個共享一個上下文的單一過程承載，這個承載者將所有組件放置在一個物理故障域中，一個故障會同時暫停每個組件，而過程的死亡會中斷過程所主持的每個會話。本文顯示，無論是建模還是計算都不將代理綁定到一個過程，語言模型的無狀態性將所有跨步狀態保持在模型之外，而健全性不變式僅在狀態空間上定義。這些觀察濃縮成四個引理，其前提是計算的假設和語言模型推理的無狀態性。基於這些引理，本文構建了Logos，一種類似ROS的跨過程代理架構，其中插件是一個過程，唯一共享的狀態是一個僅附加的記錄。在工具調用循環的四個邊界處進行的殺死操作後，八十個會話重新開始，沒有重複的效果，而與單一過程參考配置的同故障比較顯示，一個故障中斷了每個共存的會話，而在對等過程構造下，一個故障僅在一個節點結束。
